nodes.text: Claims of a new epidemic overwhelming hospitals and crematories in China are circulating on social media. Some users shared videos of crowded hospitals, alleging a rapid spread of "multiple viruses" including influenza A, HMPV, Mycoplasma pneumoniae, and COVID-19.
